title: Section 1
content: (1) This Act may be called the Merchant Shipping Act, 2025. (2) It shall come into force on such date1 as the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint, and different dates may be appointed for different provisions of this Act.
footnote: 1. 15th day of March, 2026, vide notifn. No. S.O. 1244(E), dated 10th day of March, 2026, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3 (ii).
